run_benchmark_games: run the benchmark_games module to benchmark open_spiel game rollout performance
test_rollout_until_timeout: test the _rollout_until_timeout function with a specific game name and time limit
run_benchmark_specific_games: run the benchmark on specific games separated by semicolons
run_benchmark_with_time_limit: run the benchmark with a custom time limit per game in seconds
run_benchmark_simultaneous_turn_based: run the benchmark converting simultaneous games to turn-based mode
